claim: Patchline recognizes migration frameworks far beyond Rails, Django, Alembic, Flyway, and Prisma. The inventory now detects Laravel, Ecto, Diesel, Sequelize, Knex, Doctrine, and Rails multi-database migrations from their on-disk conventions and emits the correct project-native migration command for each. The gate proves Laravel detection against the real laravel/laravel repository fetched from GitHub, and proves the full seven-framework matrix plus the correct native commands through deterministic unit tests, so Patchline can locate the data-change surface of polyglot real-world projects.
